title: Cinquantaine
identity: Gabriel-Marie, La Cinquantaine, for alto saxophone and piano, Billaudot CC2319, arranged by Georges Chauvet. This is a transcription of the composer’s 1887 cello/piano work.

evidence.claim: Billaudot identifies the alto saxophone and piano edition La Cinquantaine, catalog CC2319, arranged by Georges Chauvet, 8 pages.

Opened the public interactive preview and visually inspected the displayed opening and continuation pages. The page identifies an 8notes alto saxophone arrangement, five pages, F minor concert pitch / D minor written for E-flat alto, 2/2, Andantino around quarter note 132. Musical features observed: a lyrical line with small ornamental figures and slurs above chordal piano accompaniment; dynamics move from pp toward p and f in the continuation. This is not verified as the Billaudot/Chauvet edition.

score_observations.claim: In the public 8notes arrangement, the opening is marked Andantino and begins softly over repeated chordal piano accompaniment. The saxophone line has slurred groups and small ornaments; the displayed continuation includes longer held notes, crescendo, and a louder f marking.
score_observations.scope: 8notes arrangement only; not confirmed as Billaudot CC2319.

review_focus: Inference from inspected preview: compare the sustained/slurred saxophone line and ornaments with the piano’s chordal pulse; track the marked dynamic expansion. This is not the Billaudot edition and does not support a level assignment.
collection_flag: Transcription of an 1887 cello work. This does not establish a younger-player audience; saxophone-edition demands remain uninspected.

listening.description: Page links to the score’s saxophone MP3 and piano play-along; not confirmed as the Billaudot/Chauvet edition.
listening.verification: Link presence verified in the opened score page; not auditioned.
